items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I just, that's what makes me love Basset Day. He's a wonderful guy, you know, if you want to know it.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Well, his daddy played drum in Gabriel's band. Yes. Oh, we had, he was a good drummer too, you know, through Ed Dixieland. That's, that's the only musician that they had in the all at that time, the country boy, see, when he come here, and they didn't read, you know. Most of the musicians didn't read. That's why, first, when I started playing with him, well now, Basset was playing right across the street from where we was playing, you see. And so first we put that music up there, you know, and that…
